welcome.title: Sea Garden
welcome.introduction: Start with 40 shells and three Sea Lettuce cultures. Rake a seabed tile, choose the culture in slot 6 and tap the bed to plant. Feed it with the nutrient pump, then cut and sell your mature harvest.

hoe.title: 🔱 Sand Rake
hoe.description: Rake a flat patch of seabed to prepare a growing bed.

seeds.title: 🧪 Starter cultures
seeds.description: Choose a culture on your hotbar or equip it at the market. Tap a prepared bed to plant.

wateringCan.title: 🫧 Nutrient Pump
wateringCan.description: Feed each culture with a dose of nutrients to start its growth.

scythe.title: ✂️ Harvest Shears
scythe.description: Clip mature specimens and collect the harvest in your pack.

growthStages.title: Growth stages
growthStages.description: Cultures grow while nourished. Use the pump again when the nutrient supply runs out.

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.description: Tap a mature crop with your shears. Open the Reef Market and sell your harvest for shells.

timeControl.title: Dive clock
timeControl.description: Use the speed buttons beside the clock to fast-forward growth. Cultures need nutrients to grow.

inventory.title: Dive pack
inventory.description: Press I to open your pack and drag a culture onto your hotbar.

hotbar.title: Hotbars
hotbar.description: Press Q to switch hotbars, then use a number key to select a slot.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: Move with WASD or drag with the middle mouse button. Scroll to zoom.
